Name: Stalker
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: Somewhat reptilian in appearance, the mecite stalker has a long body made of crystal and minerals. It has large forearms with sharpened mecite talons attached, and a long whipping crystal tail with a stinger on its end. These stalkers are well-suited to hunting within underground amniatic veins, where they can freely climb the walls.

Stat Blocks.title: Stalker
languages: understands the languages of creatures it has taken memories from, but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Amniatic Miasma
traits.description: When a creature starts its turn within 10 feet of the stalker or moves there for the first time on their turn, they must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure they are afflicted with mild amniasis, and their Wisdom score is immediately reduced by 1d3. This damage cannot be restored as long as they have amniasis.

traits.name: Critical Susceptibility
traits.description: When the stalker takes damage from a critical hit, it takes twice as much damage from the extra damage dice.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The stalker makes two Mecite Claw attacks and one Mecite Tail attack.

actions.name: Mecite Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 6 (1d10) psychic damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled and restrained (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Mecite Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 6 (1d10) psychic damage.

actions.name: Self Stealer
actions.description: The stalker attempts to consume the memories of a creature it is grappling, who must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure they take 33 (6d10) psychic damage and their Wisdom score is reduced by 1d4, or half as much damage and their Wisdom isn’t reduced on a success. A creature whose Wisdom is reduced to 0 by this effect dies and becomes an amniatic drudge.

bonus_actions.name: Command Drudge
bonus_actions.description: An amniatic drudge within 60 feet of the stalker can use its reaction to Dash, make a single weapon attack or use their Multiattack feature (if they have one).
